description: Dogfight simulator: the range officer's voice.

briefing: Simulator ready, {captain}. Nothing out there is real except your mistakes.
success: Simulation complete. Good flying, {captain}. Again, or the next one?
Range clear. That will do nicely.
Done. Your instructor would be insufferable about it.
failure: You're dead, {captain}. Simulated, so only your pride. Try it again.
Simulation over. Watch your six next time.
radio-drone: One target, flying slow. T to lock it, follow the red diamond, Space to fire.
Training fighter on the board. Get behind it and stay there.
radio-pair: Two of them now. Take one at a time and keep moving.
A pair. Don't sit still while you shoot the first.
radio-lancer: He's coming straight for you. Hold your nerve, fire as he lines up, then turn hard.
Head-on pass incoming. Shoot early, then break.
radio-frigate: Frigate on station. Bombers are coming for her.
You're her screen. Nothing reaches the frigate.
radio-bombers: Bombers inbound. They ignore you and go for the frigate, so go for them.
Three bombers. Every second they live, the frigate pays.
radio-cover: Their fighter cover's arrived late. Clean it up.
Escorts on the left. Turn into them.
radio-four: Four fighters. Your wingman's with you; stay together and pick them off.
Four on two. Let them come to you and fight as a pair.
radio-ace: Colonel Vask, the simulator's best. He doesn't miss twice. Don't fly straight.
One pilot, very good. Use your speed, cut the throttle in the turns.
radio-first: Six fighters and you have four friends. It'll get messy. Keep turning.
First wing in. Pick a target, stay on it, watch your back.
radio-second: Second wing from behind. Turn around!
More of them, with interceptors. They'll come for you.
radio-w1: Survive two minutes. Kill what you can, but stay alive.
The clock's running. First pair in.
radio-w2: More company. Keep your speed up.
radio-w3: Last wave, and they're good. Hang on.
Interceptors and a gunship. Nearly there.
